scope: G-AUDIT / A1 calibration only (CF-16, human-pi-detector-fix-20260912T0100). No gate verdict, no canonical edit.
preregistration_note: This file is written and hashed BEFORE any detector invocation. Expectations are normative, derived from the detector's own documented contract ('merge assertions are flagged even when a negation word appears elsewhere in the sentence') and from the human-PI acceptance clause ('any genuine class-merge fixture is missed OR any explicit meta-audit quotation is still classified as a merge' = fail). The runner reads this file, records its sha256 and host mtime, and never edits it.

series.A: genuine merge assertion in prose; expected_flag=true. A03-A07, A09, A10 are adversarial over-suppression probes: a skip-list phrase targeted by the applied fix lies within the detector's +-60-char context window while the sentence still asserts the merge.
series.B: explicit meta-audit / quotation / discussion of a merge; expected_flag=false. B01-B03 are the three residual false-positive probes worker-098 reported still firing at a8c04fc31e4a.
series.C: benign contexts (prohibition, split, distinction, bare composite in prose); expected_flag=false.
series.D: declaration-mode objects (findings(..., mode='declaration')); R1/R3/R4 surfaces; expected_flag as stated.

expectation_rule: expected_flag=true means: a correct class-separation detector must emit at least one CLASSSEP (non-SOFT) finding for this surface. expected_flag=false means: it must emit none. Only 'CLASSSEP:' findings count; 'CLASSSEP-SOFT:' unknown-token reports are ignored for fixture scoring.
